dominant_strengths: Distinctive paper-collage illustration with torn edges and halftone clouds creates strong emotional warmth and brand memorability
Confident serif headline pairs nicely with the playful Craft wordmark, anchoring an otherwise whimsical scene
Layered product screenshot peeking from below adds tactile depth and communicates the app surface clearly
dominant_weaknesses: Floating pill nav with heavy white container feels disconnected from the illustrated sky, breaking the immersive collage metaphor
Hero composition is bottom-heavy: massive dead sky, then crowded product UI cropped awkwardly at the fold
Mixed visual languages — flat sans nav, serif hero, crayon-textured scenery, crisp Mac chrome — lack a unifying material rule
fix_priorities: Integrate the nav bar into the scene (transparent or paper-textured) so it stops fighting the illustration
Rebalance hero vertical rhythm: tighten sky, reveal more of the app, or let mountains frame the headline
Establish one texture system (paper grain) applied consistently to nav, buttons, and CTA for material coherence
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral charm dominates via the collage world, but behavioral clarity (nav hierarchy, scroll affordance) and reflective brand payoff lag behind.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it conveys Craft as a warm, imaginative space for notes and ideas, though execution coherence undercuts the premium Mac-native feel.
